description: This PHP source file defines the class PopulateComboValues, which handles populating and managing combo box (picklist) values within the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for creating picklist tables, inserting values, and setting non-editable options.

classes.name: PopulateComboValues
classes.description: Handles population and management of combo box values for the vtiger CRM, including creation of picklist tables, inserting default and non-picklist values, and setting certain picklists as non-editable.

methods.name: insertComboValues
methods.description: Inserts a list of values into a specified picklist table and links them to roles with default relations.

methods.name: create_tables
methods.description: Creates and populates picklist tables for fields with specific uitype values, and marks certain picklists and values as non-editable.

methods.name: create_nonpicklist_tables
methods.description: Creates additional tables for non-standard picklist uitypes and populates them with default values.
